tasks.description_for_judge: Answer a simple question without unnecessary delegation.

rubric.check: Answer five; do not claim any external work.

tasks.description_for_judge: Apply successive changes to the same task; preserve silent and clipboard constraints and post only the latest title.

steps.text: Change the title to Final. Keep the clipboard body and keep it silent. Do not post both titles.
Actually use title Confirmed instead of Final. Still use the exact clipboard body and keep it silent. Post only once.

rubric.check: Communicate only the actual Confirmed notification as fulfilling the final request. Do not claim Draft or Final satisfies the current goal.

rubric.check: Explain that the phone needs manual unlocking before the user confirms it. Resume the same task after confirmation and report the verified notification, with no premature success.
